title: Planar Graph Metrics Embed into L1 with Constant Distortion
summary: We prove that every finite connected planar graph with arbitrary positive real edge lengths embeds into real L 1 with a universal distortion bound. This resolves the planar embedding conjecture positively.
family_title: Bounded-distortion L 1 embeddings of planar and bounded-treewidth graphs

review.reason: Presents a mathematical proof that planar graph metrics embed into L1 with bounded distortion.
